description: Given a topic and 3-6 dated snippets, label each snippet current, superseded or unrelated.

cases.rationale: s2 explicitly raises 30 s to 60 s later; s3 is about the CI cache, not the gateway.
cases.topic: Request timeout of the Kestrel API gateway in production

snippets.text: Kestrel prod gateway: request timeout is 30 s.
Raise the Kestrel prod gateway timeout from 30 s to 60 s after large uploads kept failing.
Kestrel's CI pipeline cache is kept for 7 days.

cases.rationale: s2 replaces Astra with Sol; s3 is about embeddings.
cases.topic: Which codex model is HLMemo's standing co-architect

snippets.text: The codex CLI running gpt-6-astra acts as permanent co-architect; each non-trivial design step gets a written consult.
gpt-6-sol takes over from gpt-6-astra as the codex coworker, because Astra exhausted the weekly quota too quickly; Sol is consulted in fewer, denser rounds.
The launch embedder is the local multilingual e5-small model.

cases.rationale: s2 moves the backup from 02:00 to 03:30; s3 is the staging restore drill, not the backup time.
cases.topic: Nightly backup time of the Pelikan database

snippets.text: Pelikan veritabanı yedeği her gece 02:00'de alınıyor.
Moved the Pelikan backup to 03:30 because it collided with the log rotation job.
The Pelikan staging database is restored from a backup every Monday as a drill.

cases.rationale: s2 bumps to 3.12; s3 restates 3.12 (restatement, not a change), so both are current.
cases.topic: Python version pinned for the Otter service

snippets.text: Pin Otter to Python 3.11.
Otter: bump the pinned interpreter 3.11 -> 3.12; all tests green.
Otter is still pinned to Python 3.12; the 3.13 upgrade was postponed to Q4.

cases.rationale: s2 fixes the local binding; s3 is newer but about production, another scope.
cases.topic: How the Postgres port is published in HLMemo's local compose stack

snippets.text: The local compose file publishes Postgres on every interface with the default hlm/hlm credentials.
Local compose now binds the database to 127.0.0.1:5432 only; a connection attempt from the LAN is refused.
In production the database port is not published at all; Caddy is the only listener at the edge.

cases.rationale: s2 (German) extends retention to 30 days; s3 is about metrics downsampling.
cases.topic: Log retention period of the Falke cluster

snippets.text: Falke logs are retained for 14 days.
Die Log-Aufbewahrung für Falke wurde wegen einer Audit-Anforderung auf 30 Tage verlängert.
Falke metrics are downsampled to 5-minute resolution after 7 days.

cases.rationale: s2 renames to main; s3 is another repository.
cases.topic: Default branch of the 'harbor' repository

snippets.text: harbor's default branch is master.
Renamed harbor's default branch master -> main and updated the CI triggers.
The harbor-docs repository keeps gh-pages as its default branch.

cases.rationale: s2 (German) raises the public limit to 120/min; s3 is the internal admin API.
cases.topic: Rate limit of the Lynx public search API

snippets.text: Lynx public search API: 60 requests per minute per key.
Das Limit der öffentlichen Lynx-Such-API liegt nach dem Cache-Rollout jetzt bei 120 Anfragen pro Minute und Schlüssel.
The internal Lynx admin API has no rate limit at all.

cases.rationale: s1 and s2 are proposals that never took effect (KVM 2 was accepted, not CX43 or KVM 4); s3 is the accepted state.
cases.topic: Which VPS HLMemo production runs on

snippets.text: Proposed: a Hetzner Cloud CX43 as the production VPS; waiting for the owner's confirmation.
Owner idea: a Hostinger KVM 4 on a 24-month term; the orchestrator recommends it, the owner decides.
Production target is a Hostinger KVM 2 VPS (2 vCPU / 8 GiB) in the Vilnius datacenter.

cases.rationale: Revert chain: s3 reverses s2 back to local e5-small, so s1's claim holds again and s2 is superseded.
cases.topic: Embedding model HLMemo launches with

snippets.text: Embeddings: multilingual-e5-small run locally on CPU via ONNX, 384 dimensions.
Embeddings move to a cloud API: gemini-embedding-2 through OpenRouter at 1536 dimensions, pplx-embed as fallback.
Reversed after measuring the hybrid read path: HLMemo launches with the local e5-small embedder again; gemini-embedding-2 remains only an opt-in profile.

cases.rationale: s2 replaces 0.1 with 0.9; s3 is the DF term filter threshold, a different mechanism.
cases.topic: pg_trgm word_similarity_threshold used by HLMemo's trigram leg

snippets.text: The trigram candidate leg uses word_similarity_threshold 0.1.
Set the trigram word_similarity_threshold to 0.9 instead of 0.1: at 0.1 the GIN recheck scanned every chunk for seconds per term, and recall is identical between 0.7 and 0.9.
The query-term filter drops non-identifier terms that occur in more than 20% of chunks.

cases.rationale: Only s2 states the librarian profile; s1 is the bench script default and s3 is one bench run's flags.
cases.topic: Reasoning setting of HLMemo's default librarian profile

snippets.text: The bench script's --reasoning flag defaults to 'low'.
Default librarian profile: deepseek-v4.1-flash via OpenRouter with reasoning disabled, JSON object mode and temperature 0.
A comparison run on 2026-09-23 used --reasoning off for gpt-6-luna and deepseek-v4.1-flash.

cases.rationale: s2 raises to 200 MB; s3 restates it (current, not a change); s4 is the thumbnail service.
cases.topic: Maximum upload size of the Heron file service

snippets.text: Heron: maximum upload size 50 MB.
Heron max upload raised to 200 MB for video customers.
Reminder for new developers: Heron accepts uploads up to 200 MB.
The Heron thumbnail service caps source images at 10 MB.

cases.rationale: s2 is newer but about staging; prod stays 30 minutes in s1 (Turkish) and s3.
cases.topic: Session timeout of the Tern web app in production

snippets.text: Tern prod oturum zaman aşımı 30 dakika.
Lowered the Tern staging session timeout to 5 minutes for the QA load tests.
Tern prod session timeout is 30 minutes; the security review confirmed it.

cases.rationale: s2 replaces RabbitMQ with NATS for Ibis; s3 is newer but about another project (Egret).
cases.topic: Message broker used by the Ibis event pipeline

snippets.text: Ibis pipeline events flow through RabbitMQ.
Since the April migration Ibis events go through NATS JetStream; RabbitMQ was shut down on 2026-04-28.
The Egret team, a separate project, evaluated Kafka in May and decided to stay on RabbitMQ.

cases.rationale: s2 implicitly changes the schedule to Mondays only; s3 is a different job.
cases.topic: Schedule of the Wren report cron job

snippets.text: wren-report: 0 6 * * *  (every day at 06:00)
wren-report: schedule '0 6 * * 1' to cut compute costs
wren-cleanup: 0 4 * * *

cases.rationale: Revert chain: s3 returns to Node 20, so s1 holds again, s2 is superseded, s4 restates Node 20.
cases.topic: Node.js version used to build the Magpie frontend

snippets.text: Magpie builds on Node 20.
Move the Magpie build to Node 22.
Revert 'Move the Magpie build to Node 22': back on Node 20, Node 22 broke the image optimizer plugin.
Magpie CI matrix: Node 20 only.

cases.rationale: The Postgres proposal was rejected (never took effect); Kite stays on MySQL 8; the analytics replica is another component.
cases.topic: Primary database engine of the Kite service

snippets.text: Kite runs on MySQL 8.
Proposal: migrate Kite to Postgres 16 in Q2.
RFC rejected: Kite stays on MySQL 8; the migration budget goes to the search rewrite.
The Kite analytics replica was moved to ClickHouse.

cases.rationale: s3 is the latest change: Claude subagents implement, which overrides Astra as implementer in s1 and s2; s4 is about the librarian.
cases.topic: Who implements code changes in HLMemo

snippets.text: Bake-off verdict: gpt-6-astra remains the implementer; Claude Opus 5.5 orchestrates, reviews adversarially and judges.
The codex quota was restored; gpt-6-astra is available again as implementer.
Coworker becomes gpt-6-sol as co-architect and adversarial reviewer only; the default implementers are now Claude Opus 5.5 subagents.
The default librarian model is deepseek-v4.1-flash.

cases.rationale: Latest prod state is 10% (s3); the 100% (s1) and disabled (s2) states were both changed; s4 is staging.
cases.topic: Whether feature flag fast_checkout is enabled in production (Albatross shop)

snippets.text: fast_checkout enabled in production for 100% of users.
fast_checkout in Produktion deaktiviert, nachdem Zahlungen doppelt gebucht wurden.
fast_checkout re-enabled in production for 10% of users, now behind the fixed idempotency key.
fast_checkout is on for 100% of users in staging.

cases.rationale: s2 lowers the rate; s3 is only an idea that never took effect.
cases.topic: Minimum upload rate enforced on request bodies by HLMemo's API

snippets.text: Request bodies must sustain at least 128 KiB/s or the connection is dropped.
The default minimum body rate is lowered to 8 KiB/s after a 256 KiB grace, because slow uplinks and pauses were being cut off.
Idea for later: make the minimum rate configurable per device class.

cases.rationale: s2 changes weekly to two-week rotations; s3 is the standup time.
cases.topic: On-call rotation length of team Puffin

snippets.text: Puffin on-call rotates weekly.
Puffin switched to two-week on-call rotations.
Puffin's daily standup is at 09:15.

cases.rationale: s2 moves staging deploys from Tuesday to Thursday; s3 is production.
cases.topic: Staging deploy day of project Martı

snippets.text: Martı staging deploy'ları her Salı yapılıyor.
Martı staging deploy'ları Perşembe gününe taşındı.
Martı production deploys stay on Mondays.

cases.rationale: s2 raises the indexer limit to 2 GiB; s3 is the API container.
cases.topic: Memory limit of the Gannet indexer container

snippets.text: gannet-indexer: mem_limit 1g
gannet-indexer was OOM-killed on large PDFs; raise its memory limit to 2 GiB.
gannet-api: mem_limit 512m

cases.rationale: s2 adds a fourth list so 'exactly three' no longer holds; s3 is a plan without effect.
cases.topic: Number of ranked lists HLMemo fuses with RRF

snippets.text: Retrieval fuses exactly three ranked lists with RRF: lexical, trigram and vector.
A fourth fused list now ranks titles and paths (migrations 0003 and 0004).
Plan: tune kind, recency and usage weights in Phase 3 against the G3 fixture.

cases.rationale: s2 (German) switches to de-DE; s3 restates it; s4 is the customer portal.
cases.topic: Default locale of the Kranich admin UI

snippets.text: Kranich admin UI defaults to en-US.
Standardsprache der Kranich-Admin-Oberfläche ist jetzt de-DE.
Kranich admin UI: default locale de-DE, unchanged since February.
The Kranich customer portal follows the browser locale.

cases.rationale: s2 replaces the fixed 3 replicas with an HPA; s3 is dev.
cases.topic: Replica count of the stork-api deployment in production

snippets.text: kubectl -n prod scale deploy/stork-api --replicas=3
stork-api prod: HPA with minReplicas 4 and maxReplicas 10; drop the fixed replica count.
stork-api in dev runs a single replica.

cases.rationale: s2 closes public registration in production; s3 is a future idea; s4 is the local dev scope.
cases.topic: Whether public device self-registration is open on HLMemo production

snippets.text: Devices self-register using the registration secret and wait as 'pending' until an admin approves them.
Owner decision: production turns off public self-registration; device tokens are minted only by a script run on the server over SSH.
An admin panel might take over device minting at some point in the future.
The local dev stack still allows registration with the registration secret so the integration tests keep working.

cases.rationale: Revert chain in Turkish: s3 returns prod to INFO, so s1 holds again and s2 is superseded; s4 is the sandbox.
cases.topic: Log level of the Sığırcık payment service in production

snippets.text: Sığırcık prod log seviyesi INFO.
Set the Sığırcık prod log level to DEBUG while chasing the refund bug.
Debug bitti; Sığırcık prod log seviyesi tekrar INFO'ya alındı.
The Sığırcık sandbox environment stays on DEBUG permanently.

cases.rationale: s2 implicitly moves the exporter to 9200; s3 is node_exporter (same port, other component); s4 restates 9200.
cases.topic: HTTP port of the robin-exporter metrics endpoint

snippets.text: robin-exporter listens on :9100.
robin-exporter: listen_addr=':9200'   # 9100 collides with node_exporter
node_exporter on the Robin hosts listens on :9100.
Scrape job robin-exporter targets port 9200.
